query: How do I end my GST registration in Tamil Nadu?
reference_answer:
GST Registration Cancellation:
For GST registration cancellation in Tamil Nadu, file Form GST REG-16 on the GST portal (gst.gov.in). Provide reasons for cancellation and supporting documents. The tax officer will verify and cancel the registration.
answer: To end GST registration in Tamil Nadu, you need to deregister through the Goods and Services Tax (GST) portal. Ensure all returns are filed and settle any dues before submitting the deregistration request. [Document 1]
